urgent.ready: 4 hours after an appointment at least 2 days after applying
delivered 1 week after an appointment at least the next day after applying

note: Applying in the United Kingdom. HM Passport Office's service page says a paper form costs an extra £16.00; its fees page gives £13.50 more (£115.50 against £102): the fees page, the one for fees, is taken. Applying from abroad has other fees and times, not read here.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Passport fees
sources.said: Apply online / Apply by paper form: Adult (16 and over) standard 34-page passport £102 £115.50; Adult (16 and over) 54-page frequent traveller passport £116 £129.50; Child (under 16) standard 34-page passport £66.50 £80; Child (under 16) 54-page frequent traveller passport £80.50 £94; Passport for people born on or before 2 September 1929 Free Free.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Getting your first adult passport
sources.said: you're aged 16 or over (or will be in 3 weeks) ... An adult passport is valid for 10 years.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Get a passport for your child
sources.said: You apply for a child passport if your child is under 16. It costs £66.50 to apply online and £80 to apply with a paper form from the Post Office. A child passport is valid for 5 years.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Get a passport urgently
sources.said: 1 day premium: The earliest you can get an appointment is 2 days after you apply ... Your new passport will be ready to collect from the passport office 4 hours after your appointment. You can only use this service to renew an adult passport. It costs £239.50 (or £253.50 for a 54-page frequent traveller passport). 1 week fast track: The earliest you can get an appointment is the next day after you apply. Your new passport will be delivered to you by courier 1 week after your appointment ... It costs: £192 for an adult passport (or £206 for a 54-page frequent traveller passport) £156.50 for a child passport (or £170.50 for a 54-page frequent traveller passport)

sources.title: GOV.UK, HM Passport Office, About our services
sources.said: Processing times in the UK: You'll usually get your passport within 3 weeks. It may take longer than 3 weeks if we need more information, or we need to interview you ... You can also apply with a paper form from a post office. This costs an extra £16.00.
